task.object: Render reproducible visualizations from recorded solar-cycle backtest and Cycle 26 forecast receipts

assumptions: Input CSV and JSON receipts are authoritative and are not refit by this rendering step
Peak values use the SILSO v2.0 13-month-smoothed sunspot-number definition
Plots describe numerical evidence and preserve the recorded uncertainty and small-sample limits
mathematical_context.domain: Solar-cycle peak-strength backtest and conditional Cycle 26 forecast visualization

precision.target_tolerance: No model recomputation; plotted values are read from recorded decimal CSV/JSON receipts

candidate_implementations: Matplotlib-compatible scientific plotting not required in Mathematica
mathematica.existence_evidence: Task is deterministic rendering of CSV/JSON receipts; no Mathematica-specific operation is needed
mathematica.availability_evidence: Backend inventory reported no Mathematica installation or wolframscript

candidate_implementations: Sage plotting not required for receipt rendering
sagemath.existence_evidence: Task is deterministic rendering of CSV/JSON receipts; no SageMath-specific operation is needed
sagemath.availability_evidence: Backend inventory reported native SageMath unavailable

candidate_implementations: Python 3.12 with pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib
python.availability_evidence: Backend inventory reported /usr/bin/python3.12 with NumPy and SciPy; the plotting run completed successfully

decision.selection_reason: The requested deliverable is a reproducible local rendering of existing CSV/JSON results, and Python is the available suitable backend
decision.fallback_reason: not-required; Mathematica and SageMath are unavailable and are not needed for plotting

result.summary: Four figures were rendered from the recorded historical backtest and polar-precursor receipts; no model fitting or scientific value was changed

methods: Plotting CLI completed and emitted four PNG and four PDF figures
Reader-facing text audit returned No advisory findings
Visual inspection confirmed labels, legends, observed values, predictions, and uncertainty interval are present
verification.residual_or_error: No numerical residual was recomputed in the rendering step; all plotted values are inherited from recorded receipts
limitations: Historical backtests have small cycle-level test sets and possible serial dependence
MWO and WSO are different measurement regimes
Cycle 26 has no observed final peak label yet
The figures do not establish causal solar-dynamo claims
